sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L230-S01 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist little girl holds a visibly deflated ball that is only half inflated; protagonist father kneels beside her and checks the ball gently.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip; protagonist father in blue shirt or jacket over white top with khaki pants. Family continuity from L154/L162/L163. L058 is style reference only, not a face or clothing reference.
Scene: school playground or family front yard, safe and calm.
Composition: centered girl, father, and half-flat ball; the ball shape clearly shows one side collapsed and only half round; safe margins for phone square crop.
Style: warm hand-painted watercolor children's textbook illustration, soft edges, friendly expressions.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, labels, signs, logos, watermarks, readable marks, or printed marks on the ball.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在操場或家門前拿著一顆明顯消氣、扁掉一半的球，旁邊可有主角爸爸蹲下來幫她看球。畫面重點是「球沒氣，只剩一半鼓起來」。不可有文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L230-S02 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist father stands beside an old-looking small electric toy car or child-size electric ride-on car; the car light is very dim, and father is preparing to charge it while protagonist little girl watches.
Visual cast: protagonist father in blue shirt or jacket over white top with khaki pants; protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. Family continuity from L154/L162/L163. L058 style only.
Composition: centered old electric toy car, dim light, charging cable handled safely by father, girl nearby, safe margins.
Style: warm watercolor family-life illustration.
Avoid: no battery numbers, battery icons, instrument text, car plates, labels, logos, brand marks, signs, written text, numbers, or watermarks.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角爸爸站在一台看起來老舊的小電動車或電動玩具車旁，車燈很暗，爸爸正準備幫車充電，主角小女孩在旁邊看著。畫面要表現「舊車電量很少」，但不可出現電量數字、儀表文字、車牌、標籤或任何可讀文字。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L230-S03 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. At a school entrance or classroom, protagonist little girl smiles and greets several new classmates as if she already recognizes all of them; a recurring teacher smiles nearby in the background.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip; new classmates are distinct children with varied hair and clothes; recurring teacher uses teacher identity with short tied-back dark hair, rectangular glasses, teal cardigan over pale yellow top, distinct from protagonist mother and L058 adult woman.
Composition: protagonist girl centered greeting a small group of classmates, teacher secondary, safe margins and no crowding.
Style: warm watercolor children's school illustration, friendly and clear.
Avoid: no name tags, classroom labels, school names, text, numbers, signs, badges, logos, watermarks, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 學校教室或校門口，主角小女孩開心地向幾位新同學打招呼，表情像是已經都認得了。可有老師在旁邊微笑看著；老師要使用 recurring teacher identity，不能長得像主角媽媽，也不能複製 L058 成人長相。不可有姓名牌、文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.imageNotes: 家裡餐桌上，主角小女孩面前的碗或盤子裡飯明顯只剩一半，主角媽媽在旁邊看著她吃飯。畫面要清楚呈現「飯剩一半」。不可有文字、數字或標籤。
